reasons.A: Core king: a gold spiked crown over flared black pauldrons cut by wide molten-orange seams, a cross crack on the breast and a heavy black war-cape; the clearest regal outline from the ARPG camera (second critic 7.65, first; first critic 7.35, second).
reasons.C: Godforged: long gold-capped horns sweeping wide over glowing eye slits, a burning diamond heart on the chest and seams over gold-ridged pauldrons; the most distinctive outline front and back (second critic 7.475, second; first critic 7.0, third).
reasons.D: Vent lord: a tall gold-crowned helm with a glowing vent chimney and gold-rimmed vent chimneys rising from the shoulders, molten seams front and back; reads from above and fits the Core (second critic 7.025, third; first critic 7.65, first).

fixes.A: Thin the crown to fewer tines with a molten gem at its base, and cover the olive waist gap with a hip plate.
fixes.C: The horns weaken from the ARPG camera: angle and thicken them so they read from above, frame the diamond heart, add a hip plate.
fixes.D: Too much Neon and gold for an aura to sit on: keep Neon to the vent caps and one seam, cut the gold trim, fewer and bigger vents.

notes: 6 of 6 survived the draft and the rework with no resume. EPIC set: the same three led both critic passes (pass 1 D, A, C; pass 2 A, C, D), the steadiest ranking in the wave. Black, molten orange and gold carry the EPIC read from above far better than Basaltplate's black and red; the risk is over-lighting (D) before the game adds its worn particle effect. Every set leaves the dummy's olive hips showing.
